components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Blue pill with a pink ink under-print.
components.css: .ds-boton { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: .55rem; background: #2c3fd6; color: #ffd23f; font: 800 1rem/1 'Atkinson Hyperlegible', system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: .02em; text-decoration: none; border: 0; cursor: pointer; padding: .95rem 1.25rem; border-radius: 999px; box-shadow: 0 3px 0 #ff4fa0, 0 10px 18px -10px rgba(23,20,58,.7); transition: transform .25s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), box-shadow .25s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), background .2s; } .ds-boton:hover { background: #6b2fb3; transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 5px 0 #ff4fa0, 0 14px 22px -12px rgba(23,20,58,.7); } .ds-boton:active { transform: translateY(1px); box-shadow: 0 1px 0 #ff4fa0; } .ds-boton:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #2c3fd6; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Tab
components.description: Outlined pill tab with display letter; selected fills blue.
components.css: .ds-tabs { display: flex; gap: .5rem; } .ds-tab { font: 800 1rem/1.1 'Atkinson Hyperlegible', system-ui, sans-serif; color: #2c3fd6; background: transparent; border: 2.5px solid #2c3fd6; border-radius: 999px; padding: .7rem 1.1rem; cursor: pointer; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: .55rem; transition: background .2s, color .2s; } .ds-letra { font: 800 1.35rem/1 'Bricolage Grotesque', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif; font-variation-settings: 'wdth' 75; } .ds-tab:hover { background: rgba(44,63,214,.1); } .ds-tab[aria-selected='true'] { background: #2c3fd6; color: #ffd23f; box-shadow: 0 3px 0 #ff4fa0; } .ds-tab:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #2c3fd6; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Toggle
components.css: .ds-conmutador { display: inline-flex; border: 2px solid #17143a; border-radius: 999px; padding: 3px; gap: 2px; } .ds-conmutador button { font: 700 .85rem/1 'Atkinson Hyperlegible', system-ui, sans-serif; background: none; border: 0; padding: .55rem .9rem; border-radius: 999px; cursor: pointer; color: #17143a; } .ds-conmutador button[aria-pressed='true'] { background: #17143a; color: #ffd23f; } .ds-conmutador button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #2c3fd6; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Tag
components.css: .ds-tag { display: inline-block; font: 700 .76rem/1 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; background: #ff4fa0; color: #17143a; padding: .3rem .45rem; border-radius: 3px; } .ds-est { font: 700 12px/1 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; color: #6b2fb3; border: 1.5px dashed currentColor; padding: .12em .35em; border-radius: 3px; }

components.name: Contents Bar
components.description: Sticky blue bar; pink fill on hover and current.
components.html: BituPortadaPedido
components.css: .ds-sumario { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: .25rem; min-height: 56px; padding: 0 16px; background: #2c3fd6; } .ds-sumario a { color: #ffd23f; text-decoration: none; font: 700 .82rem/1 'Atkinson Hyperlegible', system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: .04em; text-transform: uppercase; padding: .7rem; border-radius: 4px; } .ds-sumario .ds-marca { font: 800 1.35rem/1 'Bricolage Grotesque', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif; font-variation-settings: 'wdth' 75; text-transform: none; display: flex; gap: .5rem; align-items: center; margin-right: 1rem; } .ds-marca i { width: 10px; height: 10px; background: #ff4fa0; display: inline-block; } .ds-sumario a:not(.ds-marca):hover, .ds-sumario a[aria-current='true'] { background: #ff4fa0; color: #17143a; } .ds-sumario a:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #ffd23f; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.css: .ds-pedido { background: color-mix(in srgb, #ffd23f 55%, white); border: 2px solid #17143a; border-radius: 6px; padding: 1.1rem 1.25rem 1.25rem; position: relative; box-shadow: 0 14px 30px -18px rgba(23,20,58,.55); rotate: -.6deg; margin-top: 16px; } .ds-pedido::before { content: ''; position: absolute; top: -14px; left: 50%; width: 110px; height: 26px; translate: -50% 0; rotate: 3deg; background: color-mix(in srgb, #ff4fa0 70%, transparent); } .ds-nombre { font: 800 1.9rem/1 'Bricolage Grotesque', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif; font-variation-settings: 'wdth' 80; color: #2c3fd6; margin: 0 0 .8rem; } .ds-precio { font: 800 3rem/1 'Bricolage Grotesque', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif; font-variation-settings: 'wdth' 75; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; color: #2c3fd6; margin: 0; }

narrative.overview:
The system is a stapled research zine printed on yellow stock with two risograph inks: federal blue and fluoro pink. Every surface reads as a sheet (`hoja`) in a bound pamphlet; sections are separated by staples on a dashed fold, some sheets flip to full blue ink, and inserts drop onto pink paper. Pink is the second pass of ink, so it appears as a slight misregistration behind blue display type and as a solid under-print beneath selected controls.

Density is that of a dense technical dossier: tables, specs, and numbered lists set in a hyperlegible body face, with numbers in a monospace data voice. Display type is condensed, heavy, and tight, and it carries the personality; the body stays calm and readable. A fixed multiply grain over the whole page gives the paper its tooth.
keyCharacteristics: Yellow paper ground, blue ink for structure and display, pink ink as the second pass.
Condensed 800-weight Bricolage Grotesque with a pink offset shadow for headlines.
Sheets, staples, tape, and full-bleed inverse blue sheets as the section grammar.
Monospace tabular figures for every price, quantity, and estimate.

rules.name: The Two Inks Rule
rules.body: Colour comes from blue and pink ink on yellow or pink paper. Violet is only their overprint; no other hue enters.

rules.name: The Second Pass Rule
rules.body: Pink sits behind or beneath blue, offset like a misregistered plate; it is ink, not a glow.

rules.name: The Tabular Figures Rule
rules.body: Every number that can be compared (price, count, estimate, pin) is mono or display with `tabular-nums`.

dos: Do set display type in Bricolage Grotesque 800 at wdth 75 with the pink misregistration offset.
Do separate sections as sheets: staples, blue `tinta` sheets, pink inserts.
Do put the pink ink under pressed or selected controls as a solid 3px under-print.
Do set every comparable number in JetBrains Mono or display type with tabular figures.
Do honour `prefers-reduced-motion`: the reprint, blink, and float animations switch off.
donts: Don't introduce a hue beyond the two inks, their overprint violet, and the paper stocks.
Don't use blurred glows or coloured soft shadows; depth is paper and offset ink.
Don't set long reading text in the display face or the mono.
